newsitem.title: FRANCE: Carrefour wants 500 outlets in five years.
newsitem.headline: Carrefour wants 500 outlets in five years.

text.p: Carrefour Supermarche SA chairman Daniel Bernard said on Thursday he wants the French retailer to have 500 outlets in five years, compared to 275 as of the end of 1996.
At a general shareholder meeting, Bernard said Carrefour expected 1997 pre-tax turnover to increase by 10 percent to 170 million francs.
He said net attributable profit would increase by 15 to 20 percent for the year from 3.12 billion francs last year.
The situation is weak in France and Spain, better in Brazil, depressed in Argentina and satisfactory in Taiwan, Bernard added.
